construction.cap: each security capped at 0.45 after sizing; excess stays cash
construction.class: within each primary class choose up to two eligible members; class score is their mean declared score; select top three classes, with deterministic alphabetical class ties; each class has gross budget 0.98/3 times selected_count/2; divide it by inverse volatility
construction.downstream: transparent construction-only family: no financial ridge, XGBoost, activity or USD overlay; it is not FR25 and does not amend the rejected expanded FR25
construction.duplicate_rule: inherit frozen parent admission: highest prior-63-session median raw dollar volume per duplicate group, then permanent candidate ID
construction.overlap_rule: broad parent/child fund conflicts listed below cannot be co-selected. Pooled selection greedily skips conflicts by score; class selection greedily skips conflicting members against already chosen classes, recomputes each remaining class's available top two and score, and chooses the next class. Within-class selection also skips conflicts. No look-through independence is claimed.
construction.pooled: top six eligible members by the declared score; inverse-volatility weights; gross budget 0.98 times selected_count/6
construction.primary_class_rule: one class per fund; each class gets at most one class-selection vote
construction.unfilled_slots: cash, including missing class slots; do not redistribute unused budgets

score.cash_like_funds: BIL remains a candidate, with the same positive momentum and volatility tests; report bill weights and low-volatility dominance explicitly
score.eligibility: shared prior-253-observation, raw-dollar-liquidity and duplicate admission mask; positive raw 126-session momentum; finite strictly positive volatility
score.raw: 126-session adjusted close return, ending at the prior session close
score.risk: raw score divided by 63-session sample standard deviation of adjusted daily simple returns, annualized by sqrt(252)
score.zero_volatility: unavailable for every arm; never impute or add a fitted volatility floor
